propositions: The reconciler hardcodes status != 'Done' in JQL queries, missing custom Done-equivalent statuses (Closed, Resolved, Cancelled) that are workflow-specific, causing mis-scoped active sets for non-DIG/REB workflows.
jql_active incorrectly pulls Closed/Resolved issues into the active working set because they are not the literal 'Done' status, even though they belong in the Done status category.
jql_done_recent misses Closed/Resolved issues entirely, preventing them from populating the recent-Done snapshot.

Switch Done predicate from literal status = 'Done' to Jira statusCategory = Done / statusCategory != Done to become workflow-agnostic, as all Jira statuses map to To Do, In Progress, or Done categories.
Verify statusCategory predicate is applied in both jql_active (excludes Done category) and jql_done_recent (selects Done category), with single-project and multi-project fan-out behavior unchanged.
